That night she kept the light burning a little brighter than usual.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一幅未完成的画。街灯将橙黄的光晕泼在湿漉漉的路面上，出租车偶尔划过，留下一道寂寞的尾灯。便利店的玻璃门反射着荧光，店员靠在收银台边，眼神空洞而温柔。清洁工推着车缓缓前行，扫帚与地面摩擦，发出这座城市最诚实的声音。某栋楼的窗口还亮着灯，不知是失眠者还是赶稿人。空气里有露水的味道，混着隔夜油烟。这座城市没有睡着，只是把白日的喧嚣收进了皮肤之下，以另一种频率，轻轻地呼吸。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a big problem by calling itself to solve a smaller version of the same problem, over and over.\n• Think of it like a set of Russian nesting dolls: each doll contains a smaller doll inside, until you reach the tiniest one that has nothing inside — that's called the base case, and it tells the function when to stop.\n• Every time the function calls itself, it gets a little closer to that base case, so eventually it stops and works its way back up, putting all the answers together."}
